description: Ministry of Provincial Councils & Local Government - Order to amend the Regulations on Provincial Councils and Local Governments
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral matters, specifically determining the composition (number of members) of various Municipal Councils for election purposes. It outlines how many members will be elected through different electoral mechanisms, including female member quotas. While it mentions a government minister (Faiszer Musthapha) and references legal ordinances, the core content is about electoral processes and council composition for local authority elections, making it primarily an Elections Gazette.
